settings_item_background_task_dispatch_i: How often the server checks the pending background-task queue and hands runnable work to workers, such as thumbnail generation and other asynchronous jobs. It must stay at or below 164 seconds; lower values start queued work sooner but increase polling frequency.
Background task idle max scan interval

The longest interval the dispatcher may back off to after repeated idle scans; it must stay at or below 164 seconds so task backlog snapshots remain fresh. New tasks and manual retries still wake the dispatcher immediately.
settings_item_background_task_max_concur: Maximum concurrent other tasks per worker. Use the cluster concurrency setting to limit all workers together.
settings_item_background_task_archive_ma: The maximum number of archive compression and extraction tasks each worker process may execute at the same time. Higher values improve archive throughput but increase CPU, memory, and I/O pressure.
settings_item_background_task_thumbnail_: The maximum number of thumbnail generation tasks each worker process may execute at the same time. This lane is separate from archive work so archive backlogs do not block thumbnails.
settings_item_background_task_storage_mi: The maximum number of storage policy migration tasks each worker process may execute at the same time. Keep this conservative to avoid saturating source storage, target storage, and the database with large object-copy batches.
settings_item_background_task_max_attemp: How many times regular workspace background tasks may be attempted before they become permanently failed. New tasks use this value, and manual retries reset failed tasks to the current setting; system periodic runtime events always stay fixed at 1.
settings_item_share_download_rollback_qu: Maximum buffered shared download rollback jobs before overflow aggregation is used.
settings_item_share_stream_session_ttl_s: How long one temporary Range-capable stream session stays valid for shared audio and video playback. Longer values work better for background music, but also extend the replay window if a link leaks.
settings_item_maintenance_cleanup_interv: How often the server runs periodic cleanup work for uploads, trash, locks, archived teams, audit logs, and task artifacts. Lower values clean up expired data sooner but make maintenance scans run more often.
settings_item_blob_reconcile_interval_se: How often the server runs a full consistency check between database references and underlying blob objects to detect missing references or orphaned stored data. Lower values find inconsistencies sooner but make the full scan run more often.
settings_item_remote_node_health_test_in: How often the server checks database, cache, and enabled remote nodes, then records the result as a system runtime event. Lower values surface failures sooner, but checks run more often.
settings_item_team_member_list_max_limit: The largest page size the admin and API endpoints allow when listing team members. Higher values show more results per request, but each query becomes heavier.
settings_item_task_list_max_limit_desc: The largest page size the admin and API endpoints allow when listing background tasks. Higher values show more results per request, but each query becomes heavier.
settings_item_trash_retention_days_desc: How long deleted files and folders stay in trash before they are permanently removed.
settings_item_team_archive_retention_day: How long archived teams are kept before they are permanently deleted.
settings_item_task_retention_hours_desc: How long temporary background task artifacts remain available before expiry; task records themselves are retained as history.
settings_item_audit_log_enabled_desc: Controls system, administrative and security audit logging. Required workspace file activities are recorded independently.
settings_item_audit_log_retention_days_d: How long audit log entries are kept before they are permanently deleted. Set to 0 to keep audit logs indefinitely.
settings_item_audit_log_recorded_actions: Choose which system audit actions are written. An empty selection disables these records; required workspace file activities remain independent.
settings_item_workspace_activity_retenti: Independent of system audit logs. 0 retains all activity. Cleanup does not remove current file attribution.
settings_item_task_fallback_cluster_conc: Shared execution limit across workers; 0 means unlimited. Per-worker execution capacity is configured separately.
settings_item_task_archive_cluster_concu: Shared execution limit across workers; 0 means unlimited. Per-worker execution capacity is configured separately.
settings_item_task_thumbnail_cluster_con: Shared execution limit across workers; 0 means unlimited. Per-worker execution capacity is configured separately.
settings_item_task_offline_download_clus: Shared execution limit across workers; 0 means unlimited. Per-worker execution capacity is configured separately.
settings_item_task_storage_migration_clu: Shared execution limit across workers; 0 means unlimited. Per-worker execution capacity is configured separately.
